title: Stanford publishes a nine-part course on self-improving AI agents
friendlyTitle: Stanford shares a free course about smarter AI agents
summary: Stanford Online released the CS329A lecture playlist covering test-time compute, verifiers, reinforcement learning, tool use, memory, planning, deep-research agents and long-horizon evaluation. The nine graduate-level recordings provide a structured survey of how agents can improve through feedback and interaction.
friendlySummary: Nine video lessons explain how AI agents learn from feedback, use tools, remember information and plan longer jobs.
whyItMatters: For builders, this is a free path from agent buzzwords to the underlying methods and evaluation problems. The lectures can help teams distinguish a promising workflow from a demo that has not been tested over long tasks.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It is a useful free course for anyone who wants to understand or build AI agents carefully.
